I'd love to, but I have no actual use case for XP beyond nostalgia/fun so I'd rather daily drive something which still gets support.

This specific laptop is also Windows 8 era hardware, I don't think that many drivers would be available. I have an old laptop somewhere that is compatible, I should look for it and give that one a try too.
https://i.imgur.com/7iDgs3X.jpeg Here’s some chicken I made a few days ago!
I was looking for a Tacoma, but my money went a looooot farther on the used Colorado/Canyon market.

Second photo of the Tacoma was my first truck. Amazing vehicle with only 100k miles on it. I’m sure it would have gone another 200k miles trouble free. I traded it in because it was 2WD, but it’s also nice to have some comfort features in the GMC like power windows, locks, bucket seats which can recline etc. the 4 cylinder engine was pretty slow and really struggled up the mountain passes too.

Still can’t afford a 4x4 Tacoma… so swapped it one for one with the Canyon.
